articles.title: ECT Is a Controversial Treatment of Last Resort. I Wish I’d Gotten It Sooner
articles.summary: Electroconvulsive therapy, or ECT, isn’t terribly fashionable. People sometimes get an uneasy look on their faces at the mention of it. The treatment has come a long way since those agonizing scenes in Miloš Forman’s One Flew Over the Cuckoo’s Nest —but I understand why ECT still freaks people out. articles.title: The Climate Question Hanging Over Anthropic’s IPO
articles.summary: From a business, economics, or technology angle, the record-breaking Anthropic IPO is one of the biggest stories of the year. Raising around $81 billion, it was the biggest IPO of all time. And it’s perhaps the cleanest signal of how interwoven the economy has become with AI.
